paragraphs: 2 former Mustangs appeared in professional games on Friday for 2 clubs across 2 levels, with Brooks Lee producing the night's most notable performance.
He batted eighth and started at third base.
Minnesota Twins fell to San Diego Padres, 2-6.
Alejandro Garza went 0-for-4 for Hill City Howlers at Single-A. He batted first and started at second base. Hill City Howlers fell to Charleston RiverDogs, 2-3.
title: Brooks Lee highlights a busy Friday for former Mustangs
